ex.en: I really like the concept of this website.
ex.zh: 我覺得這個網站的概念非常好。

ex.en: This is the first time I've heard of this website.
ex.zh: 我第一次知道這個網站。

ex.en: Many websites are supported by revenue from advertising.
ex.zh: 很多網站靠廣告收入維持營運。

website.en: a set of connected pages on the internet that belong to one person or company

weekday.zh: 平日、工作日（週一至週五）

ex.en: The weekdays are: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday.
ex.zh: 平日是星期一、二、三、四和五。

ex.en: The store is open from 9 to 6 on weekdays.
ex.zh: 這家店平日從九點營業到六點。

ex.en: I usually cook dinner at home on weekdays.
ex.zh: 我平日通常在家煮晚餐。

weekday.en: any day of the week except Saturday and Sunday

ex.en: The webpage takes too long to load.
ex.zh: 這個網頁載入太慢了。

ex.en: You can find more details on our webpage.
ex.zh: 更多細節請見我們的網頁。

webpage.en: a single page of a site on the internet

ex.en: The company offers a wellness program for employees.
ex.zh: 公司為員工提供健康促進計畫。

ex.en: The hotel has a wellness center with a spa.
ex.zh: 飯店有一座附設水療的健康中心。

wellness.en: the state of being healthy in body and mind

ex.en: The storm has weakened.
ex.zh: 暴風雨已經減弱了。

ex.en: His illness weakened him day by day.
ex.zh: 疾病讓他一天比一天虛弱。

ex.en: Time, which strengthens friendship, weakens love.
ex.zh: 時間會加深友情，卻會沖淡愛情。

weaken.en: to become less strong, or to make something less strong

ex.en: I know a man who can speak Russian well.
ex.zh: 我認識一個俄語說得很好的人。

ex.en: She could sing well when she was a child.
ex.zh: 她小時候歌唱得很好。

well.en: in a good or successful way

ex.en: I'm not feeling well today.
ex.zh: 我今天身體不太舒服。

ex.en: I hope your mother is well.
ex.zh: 希望你母親身體健康。

well.zh: 嗯、好吧（說話停頓或開頭）

ex.en: Well, I'll tell you how to spell my name.
ex.zh: 好，我告訴你我的名字怎麼拼。

ex.en: Well, let me think about it.
ex.zh: 嗯，讓我想一想。

well.en: used when you start to speak or pause to think

ex.en: She speaks French as well.
ex.zh: 她也會說法文。

ex.en: I'd like a coffee and a muffin as well.
ex.zh: 我要一杯咖啡，還要一個馬芬。

ex.en: We go to the theater once every two weeks.
ex.zh: 我們每兩週去一次劇院。

ex.en: Tom has been sick in bed for three weeks.
ex.zh: 湯姆已經生病臥床三週了。

ex.en: I promise to return this videotape within a week.
ex.zh: 我保證一週內歸還這捲錄影帶。

week.zh: the week：（週一到週五的）平日

ex.en: I'm very busy during the week.
ex.zh: 我平日很忙。

ex.en: During the week, I usually eat out.
ex.zh: 平日我通常在外面吃。

week.en: the days from Monday to Friday, when most people work

ex.en: She wears high heels to make herself look taller.
ex.zh: 她穿高跟鞋讓自己看起來高一點。

ex.en: When I was little, I would only wear pants.
ex.zh: 我小時候只穿褲子。

ex.en: The girl wore a yellow ribbon in her hair.
ex.zh: 那女孩頭髮上綁著一條黃絲帶。

wear.en: to have clothes, shoes or jewelry on your body

ex.en: Visiting all the tourist sights really wore me out.
ex.zh: 參觀所有觀光景點真的把我累壞了。

ex.en: Tom worked all day and was completely worn out.
ex.zh: 湯姆工作了一整天，累壞了。

ex.en: My shoes have worn out.
ex.zh: 我的鞋子磨壞了。

wear.en: to make someone very tired, or to become thin or broken from use

ex.en: The carpet shows signs of wear.
ex.zh: 地毯有磨損的痕跡。

ex.en: Normal wear and tear is not covered by the warranty.
ex.zh: 正常磨損不在保固範圍內。

wear.en: damage that happens to something because it is used a lot

ex.en: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.
ex.zh: 這冰太薄，承受不了你的重量。

ex.en: Is this ladder strong enough to bear my weight?
ex.zh: 這個梯子夠堅固，撐得住我的重量嗎？

ex.en: The house collapsed under the weight of the snow.
ex.zh: 那棟房子被積雪的重量壓垮了。

ex.en: John has put on a lot of weight recently.
ex.zh: 約翰最近胖了很多。

ex.en: I want to know how I can lose weight.
ex.zh: 我想知道怎樣才能減重。

weight.en: how heavy a person's body is

ex.en: Her opinion carries a lot of weight in the company.
ex.zh: 她的意見在公司裡很有分量。

ex.en: We gave more weight to customer feedback.
ex.zh: 我們更重視客戶的回饋。

weight.en: the importance or influence that something has

ex.en: The weather will change for the worse this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午天氣會變差。

ex.en: I'm going to mow the lawn tomorrow, weather permitting.
ex.zh: 如果天氣允許，我明天要去割草。

ex.en: It's dangerous to climb a mountain in bad weather.
ex.zh: 天氣不好時爬山很危險。

weather.en: the conditions outside, such as sun, rain, wind or temperature

ex.en: The company weathered the economic crisis.
ex.zh: 這家公司安然度過了經濟危機。

ex.en: We will weather this storm together.
ex.zh: 我們會一起度過這場風暴。

weather.en: to get through a difficult time without being badly harmed

ex.en: You seem to be a little under the weather.
ex.zh: 你看起來有點不舒服。

ex.en: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today.
ex.zh: 我今天覺得有點不舒服。

ex.en: It's against the law to carry weapons.
ex.zh: 攜帶武器是違法的。

ex.en: He used his umbrella as a weapon.
ex.zh: 他把雨傘當作武器。

ex.en: Patience is sometimes the most effective weapon.
ex.zh: 耐心有時是最有效的武器。

weapon.en: an object, such as a gun or knife, used to hurt or kill people

ex.en: The island lies to the west of Japan.
ex.zh: 這座島位於日本的西方。

ex.en: The sun sets in the west.
ex.zh: 太陽從西邊落下。

west.en: the direction where the sun goes down, or the part of a place in that direction

ex.en: They sailed along the west coast of Africa.
ex.zh: 他們沿著非洲西岸航行。

ex.en: The expansion of the building's west end is being studied.
ex.zh: 大樓西側的擴建正在研議中。

west.en: in or toward the direction where the sun goes down

ex.en: Columbus argued that he could reach India by going west.
ex.zh: 哥倫布主張向西航行就能到達印度。

ex.en: Columbus sailed farther west to look for a new continent.
ex.zh: 哥倫布往更西邊航行，去尋找新大陸。

west.en: toward the direction where the sun goes down

ex.en: The couple will wed in June.
ex.zh: 這對情侶將在六月結婚。

ex.en: They were wed in a small church in Tainan.
ex.zh: 他們在台南的一間小教堂結婚。

ex.en: The actor wed his longtime girlfriend last year.
ex.zh: 那位演員去年和交往多年的女友結婚了。

wed.en: to marry someone, or to get married

ex.en: Aunt Yoko is too weak to work.
ex.zh: 洋子阿姨身體太虛弱，沒辦法工作。

ex.en: He was a weak and delicate child.
ex.zh: 他小時候是個體弱多病的孩子。

weak.en: not strong in body, and not able to do much physical work

ex.en: She is weakest at science.
ex.zh: 她最弱的科目是自然科學。

ex.en: What do you think is your weak point?
ex.zh: 你覺得你的弱點是什麼？

ex.en: Sales were weak in the first quarter.
ex.zh: 第一季的銷售表現疲軟。

ex.en: A weak currency helps exporters.
ex.zh: 貨幣疲軟對出口商有利。

weak.en: not strong or successful, and showing little activity

ex.en: This coffee is too weak.
ex.zh: 這杯咖啡太淡了。

ex.en: I prefer my tea weak.
ex.zh: 我喜歡喝淡一點的茶。

weak.en: containing a lot of water, so having little taste or strength

ex.en: He got wet from the waist to the knees.
ex.zh: 他從腰到膝蓋都濕了。

ex.en: He dried his wet clothes by the fire.
ex.zh: 他在火邊烘乾濕衣服。

ex.en: The wet vase left a mark on the table.
ex.zh: 濕的花瓶在桌上留下了水痕。

wet.en: covered with or full of water or another liquid

ex.en: I am fed up with this wet weather.
ex.zh: 我真受不了這種潮濕多雨的天氣。

ex.en: The weather was not only cold, but also wet.
ex.zh: 天氣不只冷，還很潮濕多雨。

ex.en: Wet the cloth before you clean the table.
ex.zh: 擦桌子前先把抹布弄濕。

ex.en: Wet your hair before using the shampoo.
ex.zh: 使用洗髮精前先把頭髮弄濕。

wet.en: to make something covered with water or another liquid

ex.en: The company cares about the welfare of its employees.
ex.zh: 公司很關心員工的福祉。

ex.en: Animal welfare is important to many consumers.
ex.zh: 動物福利對許多消費者來說很重要。

welfare.en: the health, comfort and happiness of a person or group

ex.en: He works at the welfare office.
ex.zh: 他在社福機構上班。

ex.en: France is running a welfare state it can no longer afford.
ex.zh: 法國維持著一套它已經負擔不起的福利國家制度。

welfare.en: money and help given by the government to people who need it

ex.en: Japan needed contact with the Western countries.
ex.zh: 日本需要和西方國家往來。

ex.en: She prefers Western food to Chinese food.
ex.zh: 比起中式料理，她比較喜歡西式料理。

western.en: relating to Europe and North America, rather than Asia

ex.en: Ireland is in Western Europe.
ex.zh: 愛爾蘭位於西歐。

ex.en: Heavy rain is expected in western Taiwan.
ex.zh: 台灣西半部預計會有大雨。

western.en: in or from the part of a place that is toward the west

ex.en: My grandfather loves watching old westerns.
ex.zh: 我爺爺很愛看老西部片。

ex.en: This western was filmed in Spain.
ex.zh: 這部西部片是在西班牙拍的。

western.en: a film about cowboys in the American West

ex.en: Obviously, they are jealous of his wealth and status.
ex.zh: 他們顯然很嫉妒他的財富和地位。

ex.en: I don't care for wealth and fame.
ex.zh: 我不在乎財富和名聲。

ex.en: Needless to say, health is above wealth.
ex.zh: 不用說，健康比財富重要。

wealth.en: a large amount of money or valuable things that a person owns

ex.en: She has a wealth of experience in marketing.
ex.zh: 她在行銷方面經驗豐富。

ex.en: The website offers a wealth of information.
ex.zh: 這個網站提供大量資訊。

wealth.en: a large amount of something good

ex.en: She spends way too much time surfing the web.
ex.zh: 她花太多時間上網了。

ex.en: What web browser do you like the most?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡哪一個網頁瀏覽器？

ex.en: He studies French and web design.
ex.zh: 他在學法文和網頁設計。

web.en: the system of connected pages and sites that you look at on the internet

ex.en: This house is full of spider webs.
ex.zh: 這棟房子到處都是蜘蛛網。

ex.en: Spiders like to weave webs.
ex.zh: 蜘蛛喜歡結網。

web.en: a thin net of threads that a spider makes to catch insects

ex.en: Though he is wealthy, he is not happy.
ex.zh: 他雖然很有錢，卻不快樂。

ex.en: He is the son of a wealthy family.
ex.zh: 他是有錢人家的兒子。

ex.en: He can't be very wealthy, judging from his salary.
ex.zh: 從他的薪水來看，他不可能很有錢。

wealthy.en: having a lot of money or valuable things

ex.en: A bowl of rice weighs about 180 grams.
ex.zh: 一碗飯大約重一百八十公克。

ex.en: The baby weighed seven pounds at birth.
ex.zh: 這個嬰兒出生時重七磅。

ex.en: I weighed myself on the bathroom scales.
ex.zh: 我用浴室的體重計量了體重。

ex.en: Please weigh your bag at the counter.
ex.zh: 請在櫃檯秤一下您的行李。

weigh.en: to measure how heavy something is

ex.en: We need to weigh the pros and cons.
ex.zh: 我們需要權衡利弊。

ex.en: She weighed her options carefully.
ex.zh: 她仔細考慮了各種選擇。

weigh.en: to think carefully about good and bad points before deciding

ex.en: My dad gives me a weekly allowance that I use to buy comics and ice cream.
ex.zh: 我爸每週給我零用錢，我會拿來買漫畫和冰淇淋。

ex.en: We have a weekly team meeting on Monday.
ex.zh: 我們每週一開團隊例會。

weekly.en: happening or done once a week

ex.en: The newsletter is published weekly.
ex.zh: 這份電子報每週發行一次。

ex.en: I water the plants weekly.
ex.zh: 我每週澆一次花。

ex.en: Last night I had a weird dream.
ex.zh: 我昨晚做了一個奇怪的夢。

ex.en: The flavors of this brand's mouthwash are weird.
ex.zh: 這個牌子的漱口水味道好奇怪。

ex.en: Mary is kind of weird, isn't she?
ex.zh: 瑪麗有點怪，對吧？

weird.en: very strange and not what you expect

ex.en: Spiders like to weave webs.
ex.zh: 蜘蛛喜歡結網。

ex.en: These baskets are woven by hand.
ex.zh: 這些籃子是手工編織的。

weave.en: to make cloth or baskets by crossing threads or strips over and under each other

ex.en: The scooter weaved through the heavy traffic.
ex.zh: 那台機車在車陣中鑽來鑽去。

ex.en: We wove our way through the crowded night market.
ex.zh: 我們在擁擠的夜市裡穿梭前進。

weave.en: to move forward by turning often to avoid things in the way

ex.en: The author weaves history into her novels.
ex.zh: 這位作者把歷史融入她的小說中。

ex.en: He wove a few jokes into his presentation.
ex.zh: 他在簡報裡穿插了幾個笑話。

weave.en: to put different ideas or details together into one story or whole

ex.en: He pulled up the weed and threw it away.
ex.zh: 他把雜草拔起來丟掉。

ex.en: The weeds have completely overtaken the garden bed.
ex.zh: 雜草完全佔據了花圃。

ex.en: Could you please pull the weeds and water the flowers?
ex.zh: 可以請你幫忙拔草、澆花嗎？

weed.en: a wild plant that grows where people do not want it

ex.en: She weeded the garden.
ex.zh: 她替花園除了草。

ex.en: The first interview helps us weed out weak candidates.
ex.zh: 第一輪面試幫助我們淘汰不適合的應徵者。

weed.en: to take unwanted plants out of the ground, or to remove what is not wanted

ex.en: Jimmy often comes to see me on weekends.
ex.zh: 吉米週末常來看我。

ex.en: On weekends I got up later than usual.
ex.zh: 週末我比平常晚起。

ex.en: Are you going to be in Boston this weekend?
ex.zh: 你這週末在波士頓過嗎？

ex.en: Exercise is good for your mental well-being.
ex.zh: 運動對心理健康有益。

ex.en: The company cares about the well-being of its employees.
ex.zh: 這家公司很重視員工的身心健康。

well-being.en: the state of being healthy, comfortable and happy

ex.en: The weary travelers finally reached the inn.
ex.zh: 疲憊的旅人終於抵達了旅店。

ex.en: She gave a weary smile after the long shift.
ex.zh: 漫長的班結束後，她露出疲倦的微笑。

weary.en: very tired, especially after a long time doing something

ex.en: The long meeting wearied everyone.
ex.zh: 冗長的會議讓大家都累壞了。

ex.en: He wearied of the noisy city and moved to the countryside.
ex.zh: 他厭倦了吵鬧的城市，搬到了鄉下。

weary.en: to make someone very tired or bored

ex.en: My mother did nothing but weep.
ex.zh: 我的母親只是默默地哭泣。

ex.en: She wept reading the letter.
ex.zh: 她流淚看著信。

ex.en: She wept all the night.
ex.zh: 她哭了一整晚。

weep.en: to cry, especially because you are very sad

ex.en: Tom has no intention of going to Mary's wedding.
ex.zh: 湯姆不打算去參加瑪麗的婚禮。

ex.en: The wedding will be held in a 17th century church.
ex.zh: 婚禮會在一座十七世紀的教堂裡舉行。

ex.en: The wedding is less than three months away.
ex.zh: 離婚禮還不到三個月。

wedding.en: a ceremony in which two people get married

ex.en: They welcomed me warmly, so I felt at home.
ex.zh: 他們熱情地歡迎我，讓我覺得像回到家一樣。

ex.en: The company welcomes feedback from consumers who use their products.
ex.zh: 公司歡迎使用產品的消費者提供回饋意見。

welcome.en: to greet someone in a friendly way when they arrive

ex.en: You are welcome to do anything you like.
ex.zh: 你想做什麼都可以。

ex.en: You're welcome to stay for dinner.
ex.zh: 歡迎你留下來吃晚餐。

welcome.en: allowed and encouraged to do or use something freely

ex.en: Many people rejected the invitation to the welcome party.
ex.zh: 很多人婉拒了歡迎會的邀請。

ex.en: We received a warm welcome from the hosts.
ex.zh: 我們受到主人熱情的歡迎。

welcome.en: a friendly greeting given to someone who arrives

ex.en: The wearable records your daily activity.
ex.zh: 這款穿戴式裝置會記錄每日活動。

ex.en: The company is testing a new wearable for factory staff.
ex.zh: 公司正在測試供工廠員工使用的新型穿戴式裝置。

wearable.en: a small electronic device that you carry on your body, for example on your wrist

ex.en: What are your strengths and weaknesses?
ex.zh: 你們的優點和缺點是什麼？

ex.en: What are the company's strengths and weaknesses?
ex.zh: 公司的長處和短處是什麼？

ex.en: The warrior is conscious of both his strength and his weakness.
ex.zh: 那位戰士清楚自己的強項與弱點。

weakness.en: a fault or a lack of strength in a person or thing

weakness.zh: （a weakness for）特別喜愛（難以抗拒）

ex.en: Ann has a weakness for chocolate.
ex.zh: 安對巧克力毫無抵抗力。

ex.en: I have a weakness for spicy food.
ex.zh: 我對辣的食物毫無抵抗力。

weakness.en: a strong liking for something that you find hard to say no to

ex.en: We are going to visit my grandparents this weekend.
ex.zh: 這個週末我們要去探望祖父母。

ex.en: If we leave now, we can catch the last bus.
ex.zh: 如果現在出發，我們就趕得上末班車。

ex.en: We have been friends since we were kids.
ex.zh: 我們從小就是朋友。

ex.en: Our weekly meeting takes place every Wednesday afternoon.
ex.zh: 我們每週的會議都在星期三下午舉行。

ex.en: Wednesday is the middle of the working week.
ex.zh: 星期三是工作週的中間。

ex.en: I will call you on Wednesday after work.
ex.zh: 我星期三下班後會打電話給你。

ex.en: Westminster is an area in the center of London.
ex.zh: 西敏是倫敦市中心的一個區。

ex.en: Many tourists visit Westminster to see Big Ben.
ex.zh: 許多遊客到西敏去看大笨鐘。

wee.zh: 很小的（蘇格蘭、愛爾蘭口語）

ex.en: Would you like a wee cup of tea?
ex.zh: 你想來一小杯茶嗎？

ex.en: The baby was just a wee thing when we first met.
ex.zh: 我們第一次見面時，那個寶寶還只是個小不點。

ex.en: The little girl said she needed to do a wee.
ex.zh: 小女孩說她要去尿尿。

ex.en: The puppy did a wee on the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 小狗在廚房地板上尿尿了。

ex.en: Many villages in the region still get water from wells.
ex.zh: 這個地區的許多村莊仍然靠井取水。

ex.en: Workers dug two new wells near the school.
ex.zh: 工人們在學校附近挖了兩口新井。

ex.en: The wetland is home to many kinds of birds.
ex.zh: 這片溼地是許多種鳥類的棲息地。

ex.en: Protecting wetlands helps reduce flooding in nearby towns.
ex.zh: 保護溼地有助於減少附近城鎮的水患。

ex.en: He put a wedge under the door to keep it open.
ex.zh: 他在門下塞了一個楔子讓門保持敞開。

ex.en: She cut the cheese into small wedges.
ex.zh: 她把起司切成小楔形塊。

ex.en: I wedged the book between two others on the shelf.
ex.zh: 我把那本書塞進書架上另外兩本書之間。

ex.en: He wedged himself into the narrow gap behind the sofa.
ex.zh: 他硬擠進沙發後面狹窄的縫隙。

ex.en: Wendy is a girl's name popular in English-speaking countries.
ex.zh: Wendy 是英語系國家常見的女孩名字。

ex.en: Wendy lent me her notes after class.
ex.zh: 下課後溫迪把她的筆記借給我。

ex.en: Wesley is both a first name and a surname.
ex.zh: Wesley 既是名字也是姓氏。

ex.en: Wesley plays guitar in a small band.
ex.zh: 韋斯利在一個小樂團裡彈吉他。

ex.en: He put on his wellingtons before walking through the muddy field.
ex.zh: 他穿上惠靈頓長靴，走過泥濘的田地。

ex.en: The kids splashed in puddles in their bright wellingtons.
ex.zh: 孩子們穿著鮮豔的長靴在水坑裡玩水。

welcoming.zh: 友善的、讓人感到受歡迎的

ex.en: The hotel staff were warm and welcoming.
ex.zh: 飯店的員工親切又友善。

ex.en: They made the new student feel welcoming and included.
ex.zh: 他們讓新同學覺得受到歡迎、被接納。

ex.en: It's a welcoming little cafe with soft lights.
ex.zh: 這是一間燈光柔和、讓人感到自在的小咖啡館。

welcoming.zh: 歡迎、迎接（welcome 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The children were welcoming their grandparents at the door.
ex.zh: 孩子們正在門口迎接祖父母。

ex.en: The town is welcoming thousands of visitors this weekend.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮這個週末將迎接數千名遊客。

weaving.zh: 編織；織（weave 的現在分詞）

ex.en: My grandmother is weaving a basket from straw.
ex.zh: 我奶奶正在用稻草編一個籃子。

ex.en: They spent the evening weaving colourful cloth.
ex.zh: 他們整個晚上都在織色彩繽紛的布。

ex.en: The cyclist was weaving through slow traffic.
ex.zh: 那位單車騎士在緩慢的車流中穿梭。

ex.en: The little boy kept weaving between the tables.
ex.zh: 那個小男孩一直在桌子之間穿梭來去。

ex.en: The weaver made a beautiful rug from colorful wool.
ex.zh: 織工用彩色羊毛織出一條漂亮的地毯。

ex.en: Many weavers in the village still use wooden looms.
ex.zh: 村裡許多織工仍使用木製織布機。

ex.en: He sat down wearily after the long trip.
ex.zh: 長途旅行後，他疲憊地坐了下來。

ex.en: She smiled wearily and closed her eyes.
ex.zh: 她疲倦地笑了笑，閉上眼睛。

ex.en: She smiled weakly and thanked the nurse.
ex.zh: 她虛弱地微笑，向護理師道謝。

ex.en: "I'm fine," he said weakly from the bed.
ex.zh: 「我沒事。」他躺在床上無力地說。

ex.en: As a child, he was weakly and often caught colds.
ex.zh: 他小時候體弱多病，常常感冒。

ex.en: The weakly kitten needed extra care from the vet.
ex.zh: 那隻虛弱的小貓需要獸醫特別照顧。

ex.en: Water flowed over the weir with a soft roar.
ex.zh: 水流過堰時發出輕輕的轟鳴聲。

ex.en: Fishermen stood below the weir hoping to catch trout.
ex.zh: 漁夫們站在堰下，希望釣到鱒魚。

ex.en: He learned to weld metal pipes at a trade school.
ex.zh: 他在職業學校學會焊接金屬管。

ex.en: Workers weld the steel parts together to build the frame.
ex.zh: 工人把鋼製零件焊在一起來組成框架。

ex.en: The army bought modern weaponry from abroad.
ex.zh: 軍隊從國外購買了現代武器。

ex.en: Museums display ancient weaponry such as swords and shields.
ex.zh: 博物館展出劍與盾等古代武器。

ex.en: We ate a traditional Welsh dish in Cardiff.
ex.zh: 我們在卡地夫吃了一道傳統的威爾士料理。

ex.en: She speaks both English and Welsh.
ex.zh: 她會說英語和威爾斯語。

ex.en: The Welsh are proud of their language.
ex.zh: 威爾士人以自己的語言為榮。

ex.en: He is learning Welsh before moving to Wales.
ex.zh: 他在搬去威爾士前正在學威爾士語。

ex.en: She plans to wean the baby at about one year old.
ex.zh: 她打算在寶寶大約一歲時讓他斷奶。

ex.en: The calf was weaned after six months.
ex.zh: 小牛在六個月後斷奶了。

ex.en: He is trying to wean himself off sugary drinks.
ex.zh: 他正努力戒掉含糖飲料。

ex.en: The company wants to wean itself from old technology.
ex.zh: 公司想逐步擺脫舊技術。

ex.en: The ship sailed westward across the ocean.
ex.zh: 船向西橫越大洋。

ex.en: We drove westward until we reached the coast.
ex.zh: 我們向西開，直到抵達海岸。

ex.en: They made a westward journey in search of land.
ex.zh: 他們為了尋找土地而往西前進。

ex.en: A westward wind brought clouds to the city.
ex.zh: 一陣西向的風把雲帶到城市上空。

ex.en: The old fisherman had a weathered face.
ex.zh: 那位老漁夫有張飽經風霜的臉。

ex.en: A weathered wooden sign hung over the door.
ex.zh: 一塊被風吹日曬過的木頭招牌掛在門上方。

weathered.zh: 安然度過（weather 的過去式）

ex.en: The small shop weathered the economic crisis.
ex.zh: 那家小店撐過了經濟危機。

ex.en: Our family weathered many hard times together.
ex.zh: 我們一家人一起度過了許多艱難的時期。

ex.en: The weakest player on the team was still very good.
ex.zh: 隊上最弱的球員還是很強。

ex.en: Math is my weakest subject.
ex.zh: 數學是我最弱的科目。

ex.en: Weathering slowly breaks rocks into smaller pieces.
ex.zh: 風化作用會慢慢把岩石分解成更小的碎塊。

ex.en: The stone steps show years of weathering.
ex.zh: 這些石階看得出多年風吹雨打的痕跡。

ex.en: The committee faced a weighty decision about the budget.
ex.zh: 委員會面臨一個攸關預算的重大決定。

ex.en: He spoke on weighty matters of law and justice.
ex.zh: 他談論的是法律與正義這類嚴肅重大的議題。

ex.en: The final grade is a weighted average of all tests.
ex.zh: 最終成績是所有考試的加權平均。

ex.en: The rules are weighted in favor of large companies.
ex.zh: 這些規定偏袒大公司。

weighing.zh: 秤重；重達（weigh 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The clerk is weighing the fruit on a scale.
ex.zh: 店員正在用秤稱水果。

ex.en: The baby was weighing three kilograms at birth.
ex.zh: 那個嬰兒出生時重三公斤。

ex.en: She is weighing the pros and cons of moving abroad.
ex.zh: 她正在權衡搬到國外的利弊。

ex.en: We spent an hour weighing our options.
ex.zh: 我們花了一小時權衡各種選擇。

ex.en: The ship sailed westwards across the ocean.
ex.zh: 那艘船向西橫越海洋。

ex.en: We drove westwards until we reached the coast.
ex.zh: 我們一路向西開，直到抵達海岸。

ex.en: Each question has a different weighting in the final score.
ex.zh: 每道題在最後成績中的權重不同。

ex.en: The survey used a weighting to reflect the whole population.
ex.zh: 這項調查使用了加權，以反映全體人口。

ex.en: The Welshman sang in the village choir.
ex.zh: 那位威爾士男子在村裡的合唱團唱歌。

ex.en: A Welshman showed us the way to the castle.
ex.zh: 一位威爾士人為我們指引通往城堡的路。

ex.en: Welding is used to join pieces of metal together.
ex.zh: 焊接是用來把金屬接合在一起的。

ex.en: He took a course in welding at the technical school.
ex.zh: 他在技術學校修了一門焊接課。

wessex.zh: 韋塞克斯（英格蘭歷史上的王國）

ex.en: Wessex was an old kingdom in the south of England.
ex.zh: 韋塞克斯是英格蘭南部的一個古老王國。

ex.en: Many history books describe how Wessex grew powerful in the ninth century.
ex.zh: 許多歷史書描述韋塞克斯如何在九世紀變得強大。

ex.en: The tour guide spoke slowly to the Westerner in our group.
ex.zh: 導遊對我們團裡的那位西方人放慢了說話速度。

ex.en: Many a westerner finds chopsticks hard to use at first.
ex.zh: 許多西方人一開始都覺得筷子很難用。

ex.en: The weakened bridge was closed to heavy trucks.
ex.zh: 那座受損的橋禁止重型卡車通行。

ex.en: After the long illness, she was still weakened and tired.
ex.zh: 經過長期生病後，她依然很虛弱、很疲倦。

weakened.zh: 削弱（weaken 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The storm weakened the old wall.
ex.zh: 暴風雨削弱了那面舊牆的結構。

ex.en: Lack of sleep weakened his ability to focus.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足削弱了他的專注力。

ex.en: The children put on their wellies and jumped in puddles.
ex.zh: 孩子們穿上長筒雨靴，在水坑裡跳來跳去。

ex.en: I left a muddy welly by the back door.
ex.zh: 我把一隻沾滿泥巴的雨靴留在後門邊。

ex.en: The weeping of the child could be heard down the hall.
ex.zh: 走廊那頭都聽得到孩子的哭聲。

ex.en: There was quiet weeping at the funeral.
ex.zh: 葬禮上傳來低低的啜泣聲。

ex.en: The weeping girl held her mother's hand.
ex.zh: 哭泣的女孩握著媽媽的手。

ex.en: A weeping willow stands beside the pond.
ex.zh: 池塘邊有一棵垂柳。

ex.en: Weariness showed on her face after the long trip.
ex.zh: 長途旅行後，她臉上露出倦容。

ex.en: He felt a deep weariness with the endless meetings.
ex.zh: 他對沒完沒了的會議感到深深厭倦。

ex.en: The wearer of this jacket will stay warm even in heavy snow.
ex.zh: 穿這件外套的人即使在大雪中也能保暖。

ex.en: Each ring was made to fit its wearer perfectly.
ex.zh: 每枚戒指都是為配戴者量身打造的。

ex.en: The couple were joined in holy wedlock last June.
ex.zh: 這對佳偶在去年六月結為連理。

ex.en: In the past, a child born out of wedlock faced unfair treatment.
ex.zh: 過去，非婚生的孩子會遭受不公平的對待。

ex.en: A weasel slipped through the gap in the fence.
ex.zh: 一隻鼬鼠從籬笆縫隙鑽了過去。

ex.en: The weasel is small, quick, and has a long thin body.
ex.zh: 鼬鼠體型小、動作快，身體細長。

ex.en: He's a weasel who never keeps his promises.
ex.zh: 他是個狡猾的人，從不遵守承諾。

ex.en: Don't trust that weasel with your money.
ex.zh: 別把錢交給那個奸詐的傢伙。

weakening.zh: 變弱；削弱（weaken 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The storm is weakening as it moves inland.
ex.zh: 風暴往內陸移動時正在減弱。

ex.en: Constant noise is weakening my concentration.
ex.zh: 持續的噪音正在削弱我的專注力。

ex.en: The welder wore a mask to protect his eyes from the sparks.
ex.zh: 焊接工戴著面罩保護眼睛不被火花傷到。

ex.en: My uncle works as a welder at a shipyard.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在造船廠當焊接工。

ex.en: Astronauts feel weightless when they float inside the space station.
ex.zh: 太空人在太空站裡漂浮時會感覺失重。

ex.en: The feather seemed almost weightless in my hand.
ex.zh: 那根羽毛拿在手裡幾乎沒有重量。

ex.en: The new laptop is so thin that it feels weightless.
ex.zh: 這台新筆電薄到幾乎感覺不到重量。

ex.en: Regular exercise is good for your wellbeing.
ex.zh: 規律運動有益於你的身心健康。

ex.en: The company cares about the wellbeing of its employees.
ex.zh: 公司關心員工的福祉。

ex.en: The report was a welter of facts and numbers.
ex.zh: 這份報告是一大堆混亂的事實和數字。

ex.en: She was lost in a welter of emotions.
ex.zh: 她陷入了千頭萬緒的情緒裡。

ex.en: The small boat weltered in the stormy sea.
ex.zh: 小船在暴風雨的海上翻滾顛簸。

ex.en: Waves weltered against the rocks all night.
ex.zh: 海浪整晚翻湧著拍打岩石。

ex.en: She is wearing a blue coat today.
ex.zh: 她今天穿著一件藍色外套。

ex.en: The man wearing glasses is my teacher.
ex.zh: 戴眼鏡的那位男士是我的老師。

ex.en: Looking after small children can be very wearing.
ex.zh: 照顧小孩可能讓人非常疲憊。

ex.en: It was a long and wearing journey.
ex.zh: 那是一趟漫長又累人的旅程。

ex.en: The whip left a red welt on his back.
ex.zh: 鞭子在他背上留下一道紅腫的痕跡。

ex.en: A welt appeared where the insect had bitten her.
ex.zh: 她被昆蟲咬過的地方浮起了一塊紅腫。

ex.en: The weatherman said it will rain all weekend.
ex.zh: 氣象播報員說整個週末都會下雨。

ex.en: My dad always watches the weatherman before he goes fishing.
ex.zh: 我爸去釣魚前總要先看氣象播報員的預報。

ex.en: The garden was weedy and neglected.
ex.zh: 那座花園雜草叢生，無人照顧。

ex.en: We cleared the weedy path behind the house.
ex.zh: 我們清除了屋後雜草叢生的小徑。

ex.en: A weevil had eaten holes in the stored rice.
ex.zh: 一隻象鼻蟲把儲存的米蛀出了洞。

ex.en: Farmers worry when weevils attack the crops.
ex.zh: 象鼻蟲侵襲作物時，農民就會擔心。

ex.en: The backpack straps are made of strong nylon webbing.
ex.zh: 這個背包的肩帶是用堅韌的尼龍織帶做的。

ex.en: The old chair had worn webbing under the seat.
ex.zh: 那張舊椅子的座墊下面織帶已經磨損了。

ex.en: Weymouth is a seaside town on the south coast of England.
ex.zh: 韋茅斯是英格蘭南岸的一個海濱城鎮。

ex.en: Many tourists visit Weymouth in summer for its long sandy beach.
ex.zh: 許多遊客夏天會去韋茅斯，因為那裡有一片長長的沙灘。

ex.en: We usually eat a simple dinner on a weeknight.
ex.zh: 我們平日晚上通常吃簡單的晚餐。

ex.en: The gym is quiet on a weeknight.
ex.zh: 健身房在平日晚上很安靜。

ex.en: In the story, the man turns into a werewolf at full moon.
ex.zh: 故事裡，那個男人在滿月時變成狼人。

ex.en: The children dressed up as a werewolf for Halloween.
ex.zh: 孩子們在萬聖節打扮成狼人。

ex.en: A westerly breeze blew across the bay.
ex.zh: 一陣西風吹過海灣。

ex.en: The road runs in a westerly direction.
ex.zh: 這條路朝西延伸。

ex.en: The ship headed westerly toward the open sea.
ex.zh: 那艘船朝西駛向外海。

ex.en: The river flows westerly before it reaches the ocean.
ex.zh: 這條河向西流了一段才入海。
